title: Concatenation of buffered words
statement: For Boolean words $x$ and $u$, place the buffered copy of $u$, shifted to begin at cell $|x|$, on the cells from $|x|$ through $|x|+|u|-1$, and use the buffered copy of $x$ elsewhere. The resulting tape content is exactly the buffer storing the concatenated word $x u$.
